groups.title: ∫ sinᵐx cosⁿx dx — recipe
groups.kw: sin^m cos^n odd even power sin cos product powers cos3 sin2
f: n odd → save one cos, use cos² = 1 − sin², u = sin x.
m odd → save one sin, use sin² = 1 − cos², u = cos x.
Both odd → pick either (use the smaller power for the saved factor).
Both even → power-reducing: sin² = (1−cos2x)/2, cos² = (1+cos2x)/2 (repeat as needed).
Argument kx (e.g. cos³(2θ) sin²(2θ)): same recipe with u = sin kx, du = k cos kx dx → extra factor 1/k.

groups.title: ∫ tanᵐx secⁿx dx — decision table
groups.kw: tan^m sec^n tan sec integral tangent secant powers
f: n even (n ≥ 2) → save sec²x, rewrite the rest with sec² = 1 + tan², u = tan x, du = sec²x dx.
m odd → save sec x tan x, rewrite the rest with tan² = sec² − 1, u = sec x, du = sec x tan x dx.
m even and n odd → no clean u. Replace tan² = sec² − 1 to get odd powers of sec, then use the reduction formula / ∫sec³.
Both conditions hold (n even and m odd) → either works; take the one with fewer terms.
Argument kx → same recipe, extra factor 1/k.
\int\sec x\,dx=\ln|\sec x+\tan x|+C,\qquad \int\sec^3x\,dx=\tfrac12\big(\sec x\tan x+\ln|\sec x+\tan x|\big)+C
